headline: fshindo slips out of ARC-3 gold places

sections.text: fshindo slipped from 19th to 20th on the ARC-3 public board, at 38.20 with the score unchanged. The gold places now extend through 19th.
The gold line rose 0.02 in the past day to 38.22, leaving fshindo 0.02 short. Public standings are provisional.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
